description: This source file defines an actor 'DiagnosticsFileLog' responsible for logging diagnostic information to a JSON lines file. It includes functionalities for log rotation, directory management, and log entry creation, serving as a diagnostic logging utility within the OpenClaw application.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor that provides logging of diagnostic data to a JSON lines file, managing log rotation, directory creation, and log persistence.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled based on user preferences.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the current log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates a log record with specified category, event, and optional fields.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encodes a record as JSON and writes it to the log file.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a log record to the log file.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Rotates log files if they exceed maximum size.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Generates URL for rotated log files based on index.
